headline: Session done — easy 8km + strides landed clean, compliance 95%
summary: Prescribed was 45min Z2 (138-148bpm) plus 6x20s strides at 180+ spm. Actual: average HR 150bpm, running a bit hot of the Z2 ceiling, but RPE only 4 and feel 2 — an easy effort by feel despite the drift. Cadence averaged 84 (168 spm), still short of the 180+ target for the strides block itself, though the interval summary shows the structure was hit (6x20s hard reps at 158bpm, 6x60s walk recoveries at 160bpm — recoveries ran warmer than walking should, likely rolling into the next rep). No pain or ITB signal logged. Compliance 95.5%, so this counted as a full session.
flags: Cadence work is the whole point of this session (168 spm at Pirin under fatigue is the target problem) — average cadence here still reads low-160s/170s territory rather than a clean 180+, worth checking the lap-by-lap stride data rather than the session average, which is diluted by the 45min steady portion.
HR sat ~150 for a Z2-capped session (138-148) — mild, and RPE/feel say it wasn't a strain, but worth watching if this becomes a pattern rather than a one-off.
suggestedChange: None needed off today's data alone — if Wed/Fri sessions this week show the same cadence shortfall on strides specifically (not just session-average), consider flagging it to Alberto as a technique issue rather than a fitness one.
